meta.name: lsp
meta.description: Use when Codex needs language-server diagnostics, definitions, references, symbols, or rename safety checks in the current workspace.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 在编辑器中获取代码诊断、定义跳转和引用查找
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在代码编辑器中快速定位定义、引用或检查重命名安全
copy.tagline_en: Get language diagnostics, definitions, references, and rename safety in your editor
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need quick access to definitions, references, and rename safety in your code editor

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 可以通过语言服务器功能来检查代码问题、跳到定义、查找引用、查看符号，以及执行安全重命名。它还能显示当前哪些语言服务器已启用。
howto.when: 当你在当前项目中要求检查代码错误、跳转到定义或查找引用等，或请求安全重命名时触发。

say.text: 检查 src/index.ts 的代码错误。
say.note: 以 error 级别优先返回诊断结果。

say.text: 跳转到 getData 函数的定义。
安全地把函数 compute 改名为 calculate。
say.note: 先检查重命名是否合法，再执行改动。

howto.what_en: After setup, Claude can use language-server capabilities to check code for errors, go to definitions, find references, inspect symbols, and perform safe renames. It can also show which language servers are currently enabled.
howto.when_en: It triggers when you ask for code diagnostics, definitions, or references in the current project, or request a safe rename.

say_en.text: Go to the definition of the getData function.
Safely rename function compute to calculate.
say_en.note: Checks validity first, then applies the rename.
